title: Crop mode
body: Double-tap a photo or a clip to crop it where it sits. Drag the picture, pinch it, pull the frame in, pick a shape such as 1:1 or 9:16, straighten it with the dial, turn it a quarter or flip it. Done keeps it.

title: Brushes: erase, restore and blur
body: Edit on a photo has brushes that erase part of it, bring an erased part back, blur or pixelate where you paint. The size slider sets the brush, and Undo takes back a stroke.

title: Removing a photo's background
body: Edit on a photo can take its background out: erase what you do not want with the brush, or remove a white background from a logo. The Restore brush brings back what was taken.

title: Photo effects and filters
body: Filters set a look at any strength. Adjust has light, colour, curves and selective colour. Effects add blur, glow, duotone, shadows and more; hold Compare to see the photo without them.

title: Timeline and clips
body: Turn on the timeline in the editor's menu to see each page's length, its clips and its sound. Drag a clip's ends to trim it, split it at the playhead, and set its speed and volume.

title: Animation
body: Animate gives a page or an element a way in and out, and text can come in word by word. Page transitions play between pages in Present and in videos.

title: Music and sound
body: Audio adds music from the library, your own songs and sound effects. Each track can be trimmed, faded, set louder or quieter and fitted to the beat.

title: Voice-over
body: Record your voice over a page in Audio, or have a text read aloud as a track. Enhance voice cleans it up.

title: Captions
body: Captions write what is said in a clip or a voice-over as words on the page, made on the phone. Change their words, their style and where they sit, or bring them in from an SRT file.

title: Presenting
body: Present shows the design full screen, page by page. Tap or swipe to move on, or use the arrow keys on a keyboard. Magic shortcuts play confetti, a drumroll and more.

title: Presenter view and recording
body: Presenter view shows your notes, the next page and a timer while the audience sees only the slides. Present and record keeps you, the slides and your voice as a video to share.

title: Printing and paper layout
body: Print sends pages to a printer, or several to a sheet of A4 or Letter. The print-ready PDF adds bleed and crop marks.

title: Version history
body: Version history keeps how the design looked earlier. Preview a version page by page, restore it whole, make a copy of it, or bring back just one page.

title: Brand kits
body: A brand kit keeps your colours, fonts, logos, photos and text styles for every design. Pick its colours from a logo, and make a brand guidelines page from it.

title: Templates
body: Templates start a design from a finished one. Search them, filter by style and colour, or add one as a new page of the design you have open.

title: Your templates
body: Save as template keeps a design to start from again. Your templates can be renamed, starred, sent to someone else and brought in from a file.

title: Planning posts
body: Plan a post sets a day and time to post a design, with its caption. The planner on Home shows them on a calendar and reminds you when it is time.

title: Bulk create
body: Bulk create makes a page for each row of a table you type or paste, filling texts and photos from its columns.

title: Docs
body: A Doc is a long page of headings, words, lists, tables and pictures that flows on as you type. Export it as a Word file or a PDF, or turn a design into a Doc.

title: Whiteboards
body: A whiteboard is one page that grows as you add to it, for sticky notes, drawing, diagrams and ideas.

title: Drawing
body: Draw has pens, a marker and a highlighter in any colour and size, and an eraser. Shape assist turns a rough circle or arrow into a neat one.

title: Charts and their data
body: Add a chart, then type its numbers in its table, paste them or import a CSV. Pick a kind — bar, line, pie, donut, scatter and more — and its colours and labels.

title: Tables
body: A table can have rows and columns added and removed, cells merged, borders and colours of its own, and a design to start from.

title: QR codes and barcodes
body: Add a QR code for a link, an email, a phone number or Wi-Fi, in your own colours, or a barcode. Canvia warns when a code may not scan.

title: Checking accessibility
body: Check accessibility looks for small text, low contrast, pictures without alt text and clips without captions, and takes you to each.

title: Backing up
body: Back up everything, in Settings, keeps your designs, uploads, templates and settings in one file that either phone can restore. Back up automatically writes one to a folder you choose.

title: Sharing into Canvia
body: Share photos, videos, PDFs or design files to Canvia from another app to start a design, or add them to the one that is open.

title: Folders and starred
body: On Home, keep designs and uploads in folders and folders inside folders. Star a design or a folder to find it under Starred.

title: Uploads and Recently deleted
body: Uploads on Home lists the photos, videos, music and fonts you brought in. Deleted designs, uploads and folders wait in Recently deleted for 30 days, where they can be restored.

title: Quick file tools
body: Tools on Home merge and split PDFs, turn a PDF into pictures and photos into a PDF, and resize, convert or compress a picture, without making a design.

title: Videos, GIFs and file types
body: Share makes a video or a GIF of animated pages, a ZIP of every page, an SVG, a PowerPoint, a web page or a smaller PDF, and suggests the type that suits the design.
